title: AI Gateway logs per_page exceeds the API maximum of 50
description:
Found by the live run immediately after 97x fixed the filter shape — the next layer of the same untested query. cloud/factory/src/gateway.ts sets LOG_PAGE_SIZE = 100; the API caps per_page at 50 and answers 400 "Number must be less than or equal to 50".

Verified against the real API on the operator account:
  per_page=50 -> HTTP 200
  per_page=51 -> HTTP 400

Fix: set LOG_PAGE_SIZE to 50 and pin it with a test asserting it is <= the documented maximum, the same shape as the platform-cap guard the PBKDF2 fix uses (a named constant plus a test citing the limit). MAX_LOG_PAGES = 20 then covers 1000 log rows per run, which is the pagination budget worth stating in a comment.

While in there: the run failed with "cost budget cannot be enforced" for a query bug rather than a genuine telemetry outage. Consider whether a 400 (a bug in OUR request) should be distinguished from a 5xx or network failure (a real outage) in the message, since they need different fixes from the operator — one is "report this", the other is "retry or check the gateway".

acceptance_criteria: The logs query uses per_page <= 50 and a test fails if it is raised above the documented maximum; a run with a configured cost budget reads its telemetry and proceeds past acquireContext; a request-shape error is distinguishable from a telemetry outage in the operator-facing message.
closed_reason: Completed: the AI Gateway logs query uses per_page at the API's documented maximum of 50, pinned by a named constant and a test that fails if it is raised, and a request-shape error is now distinguishable from a telemetry outage in the operator-facing message.
